story_zh: 今天我在网上购物。我选择了一双蓝色的皮鞋、一条绿色的裙子和一顶帽子。我还买了一件衬衫和一条裤子，花了三百元。我用信用卡付款，超市送了我一张伞。最后，我在旧货市场找到了一个包，只花了五角。
story_pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ zài wǎngshàng gòuwù. Wǒ xuǎnzé le yī shuāng lánsè de píxié, yī tiáo lǜsè de qúnzi hé yī dǐng màozi. Wǒ hái mǎi le yī jiàn chènshān hé yī tiáo kùzi, huā le sānbǎi yuán. Wǒ yòng xìnyòngkǎ fùkuǎn, chāoshì sòng le wǒ yī zhǎng sǎn. Zuìhòu, wǒ zài jiùhuò shìchǎng zhǎo dào le yī gè bāo, zhǐ huā le wǔ jiǎo.
story_en: Today I shopped online. I chose a pair of blue leather shoes, a green skirt, and a hat. I also bought a shirt and a pair of pants, spending three hundred yuan. I paid with a credit card, and the supermarket gave me an umbrella. Finally, I found a bag at the flea market for only five jiao.
